There are 3 ways to add this:
* As an EditorPlugin (kind of limited)
* As a custom C++ module
* Part of editor's source code

I think the feature would benefit a lot if it was made as a part of the editor code.
answers.workaround: I belive many people will use this feature. Definitely can't be worked around with few lines of code.
